snippet.title: STRIDEN | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
It's probably the world's first round-based, team-based survival shooter ever made. Made by a Swedish indie studio in the north. 

The Scandinavian peninsula has become the frontline in the battle between East and West. Tactical nuclear warfare has devastated society and a massive evacuation helped many escape - not everyone could be saved.

Loot, Build, Plunder, and send the radio signal for freedom. STRIDEN is the fast-paced, sandbox looter shooter survival game that’ll get your blood pumping. Your team of five is battling against three other teams to collect 15,000 points and be the first to activate the radio transmitter for the extraction helicopter.

Join the Early Access at Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052970/STRIDEN/

Join our Discord Community: 
https://discord.com/invite/Wyjcw5Qu6B
